event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-only tape, breadth collapsed.
Core PCE cooled to 0.2% m/m (fc 0.3%) and 3.0% y/y (fc 3.3%), yet SPY fell 0.21% while only QQQ and SOXX closed green — a dovish inflation print bought megacap tech and nothing else. ADP 9k vs 7k fc and Chicago PMI 58.8 vs 51.2 fc confirmed hot growth, keeping Polymarket hike odds at 34% for Oct 28.

INDICES — VIX 16.3, above its 15.8 20-day MA.
QQQ +0.25% > SOXX +0.21% > SPY -0.21% > IWM -0.40% > DIA -0.84%. Large beat small by 0.65pp. Oil was the notable cross-asset move, USO +1.61%, with TLT -0.58% the second. SPY's 21% above-50DMA reading is the real story, not the index level.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.4x with price -0.21%: distribution into strength. QQQ ran roughly average volume — the +0.25% came on no conviction, a low-conviction rally. IJR 1.6x and IJH 1.4x on down days is heavier small-cap selling, while SOXX 0.6x shows nobody wants chip exposure here despite the +0.21%. Breadth diverges hard: 120 advancers vs 381 decliners, 21% above the 50-DMA, 0.56 up/down volume, 12 new highs vs 118 new lows.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +0.64%, XLE Energy -0.06%, XLY Discretionary -0.28%, XLC Comms -0.45%, XLU Utilities -0.68%, XLB Materials -0.81%, XLRE Real Estate -1.04%, XLF Financials -1.13%, XLI Industrials -1.27%, XLV Healthcare -1.35%, XLP Staples -1.53%. Top industries: USO +1.61%, TAN +1.24%; bottom: WGMI -2.60%, MSOS -11.20%. Flows confirm the concentration: XLK +147 (60p) and XLY +711 (100p) took inflows, while XLF bled -2305 (0p) and XLV -1089 (2p). Money is going into tech/discretionary and out of financials and healthcare — narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.05 is elevated protection demand; QQQ 0.75 sits mid-range. Both skews positive (SPY +7.0%, QQQ +6.4%) — put premium bid. VIXEQ 39.8 vs VIX 16.3 is a wide gap: high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a macro-correlated one. SPY GEX flip 665 vs spot well above — no amplification risk yet.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +1.61% on EIA crude build of 92.2 vs -26.4 fc is a head-scratcher; dollar +0.07% and TLT -0.58% show duration still leaking. Next FOMC Oct 28: Polymarket says 66% hold, 34% hike, with hike odds -29pp in five days — the market is fading the hawkish tail even as growth prints run hot. 2-3 sentences.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50.6, Neutral. NOC -4.19% (GF Value calls it undervalued), MP +4.09% on its mine-to-magnet push, CEG -3.99%, FNV -3.96% on 5.1x volume — that's distribution, not accumulation. MSOS -11.20% on 4.3x volume is the ugliest print on the board. Watch QQQE -0.17% on 2.4x volume (equal-weight divergence from QQQ), XLU -0.68% on 2.2x (defensive unwind), and EMR -1.36% on 2.0x in the Industrial 7.
